<!--
  One entry of a menu: a link to its address, or, without one, its content as text in the same box (the magazine
  routes nothing, so it shows text). current marks the page the entry stands for (aria-current) either way.
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type MenuEntryProps = {
  href?: string;
  current?: boolean;
  variant?: "default" | "muted" | "block";
  size?: "default" | "sm";
  testid?: string;
  block?: boolean;
  class?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import { urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  href,
  current = false,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  testid,
  block = false,
  class: className,
} = defineProps<MenuEntryProps>();
defineSlots<{ default?(): unknown }>();
</script>

<template>
  <Link v-if="href"
    :href="urlOf(href)"
    :variant="variant"
    :size="size"
    :aria-current="(current ? 'page' : undefined)"
    :class="className"
    :data-testid="testid"
  >
    <slot />
  </Link>
  <Box
    v-else-if="block"
    :class="className"
    :aria-current="(current ? 'page' : undefined)"
    :data-testid="testid"
  >
    <slot />
  </Box>
  <Inline v-else :class="className" :aria-current="(current ? 'page' : undefined)" :data-testid="testid">
    <slot />
  </Inline>
</template>
